scope: read-only primary source plus abstract model negatives, no native reproduction

checks.name: actualPinFloatingAndAnyFullscreenRefusal
checks.boundedConsequence: Native MAX must be accepted through a proper changed owning core API, not an unchanged PinAction call.

checks.name: preRawModalRefusal
predicates: Refusing focus to window shadowed by modal dialog
checks.boundedConsequence: A rawWindowFocus-only hook cannot reroute the path rejected by preceding modal-parent guard.

checks.name: originalOwnerFollowups
checks.boundedConsequence: Rerouted or refused fullWindowFocus does not rewrite caller local owner; original-owner followups need typed actual accepted target.

checks.name: legacyIndependentBitCopy
checks.boundedConsequence: Effective protection and independent child pin intent are conflated by two real source writes.

checks.name: renderFloatingOnly
checks.boundedConsequence: Adding native tiled MAX pin alone omits protected owner from final pin pass.

checks.name: hitFloatingOnly
checks.boundedConsequence: Final render band and native hit protection require matching nonfloating MAX policy.

checks.name: coreFocusPrecedesSeatAcceptance
checks.boundedConsequence: Core owner can change before native Seat acceptance; no atomically inferred owner+Seat success.

checks.name: surfaceRefusalOrMissingKeyboard
checks.boundedConsequence: Seat refusal/lack of keyboard must retain partial actual observation and suppress success followup.
